main_measure.name: OLS slope of forward 10-bar excess log return on forecast, short-bar blocks
main_measure.threshold: confirm if slope t >= +2 with mean excess on short blocks < 0 and decline share higher than on all blocks; reject if slope t <= -2; otherwise inconclusive; inconclusive if fewer than 15 non-overlapping short blocks

supporting_check.name: share of negative 10-bar returns, short blocks minus all blocks

decided_by: Slope t-statistic -0.24 lies between -2 and +2: inconclusive.
reading: Blocks start at rows 0, 10, 20, ... of each window with the forecast read at the block's first bar, the buy-and-hold baseline is the mean forward 10-bar log return over all blocks on that same grid, and the component's raw column is found by its last_history_value name since the record calls it below_sma200 rather than below_ma.
